pax_corpinc3d_whatsnew_1_6_0:
• Big cities are real quarters now: round the corporations' buildings a grid of streets with traffic and dense blocks — houses on lots, taller to the middle, towers, parks. The city's size follows the real city's people.
• 1,169 real airports (OurAirports): a runway along its real heading with markings, a taxiway, an apron, a terminal and a control tower. Hover the IATA code — the name and the city.
• The planes fly between airports: the take-off run, the climb, the route, the approach lined up with the runway, the touchdown, the roll, a stop and the flight back. Smaller on the ground to fit the runway, larger in the sky to be seen from orbit.
• The air route's dashes follow the plane's real way, runway to runway.
• A new «Airports» layer in «Globe layers» (Tab).
• Thinner clouds: the thin haze no longer veils the planet, the ground shows through thick clouds, their shadows are lighter.
• The game's own clouds no longer lie over ours: the game showed its shell again every frame — now it is simply not drawn.
pax_corpinc3d_whatsnew_1_5_0:
• Planes are real 3D airliners: they fly the game's air routes and between the biggest cities, not white dots.
• Ships are seen from orbit: a white wake behind, a bigger hull.
• Armies are bigger (armoured car, soldiers, a ring in the country's colour), the strength label above them, not over them.
• Power lines are back: amber wires and pylons between cities (the thin wires were drawn as dots).
• Province indicators as icons (health, education, safety, corruption, communications, power grid) on a disc of the grade's colour; hover — the name and the value.
• Trees no longer vanish when the quality steps down to «Eco» by itself — there are just fewer.
• The running dots of trucks, ships and planes are gone from the routes.
• «Clean 2D map» (the 3D gear, on): the corporations' buildings and the roads along cities are no longer drawn on the game's flat map — they are 3D. Clear it and it comes back.
• Console: inc3d layers — what the 3D layers see (armies, ships, planes).
pax_corpinc3d_whatsnew_1_4_4: • Military bases on the globe show a fortress on a plate in the country's colour (gold edge for yours, faded while being built), like on the game's map, instead of a bare coloured square.
pax_corpinc3d_whatsnew_1_4_3: • The 3D settings are now behind a gear at the bottom left, above the game's chronicle — the «3D» button of the bottom bar is gone.
pax_corpinc3d_whatsnew_1_4_2: • Hover a corporation's building on the globe — a bubble pops up: name, country, industry, value and the week's change, status.
pax_corpinc3d_whatsnew_1_4_1: • The seams between the ground's pieces are hardly seen now: the far ground is finer, the transitions farther from the camera.
pax_corpinc3d_whatsnew_1_4_0_title: trees, large armies and ships, every satellite
pax_corpinc3d_whatsnew_1_4_0:
• Forests grow on the Earth by NASA's pictures (layer «Trees» in «Globe layers»).
• Armies and ships are large now — seen from the usual height.
• Power lines are seen from afar, clouds melt as you come close.
• The new model on every satellite and station, the ISS too.
• The economy's indicators and the map's data are found under game 0.24's new names.
pax_corpinc3d_whatsnew_1_3_0:
• The 3D Earth has 4,596 provinces instead of 1,999: real regions, states and counties (Natural Earth). Country and region borders follow exact lines, no staircase.
• The corporations' sites are set by the new provinces: those standing in the sea or a few km over a border moved onto their own land.
• Air routes are white.
pax_corpinc3d_whatsnew_1_2_1_title: no crash on a click on a country
pax_corpinc3d_whatsnew_1_2_1: • The game no longer crashes on clicks on a country on the globe: its regions' map is drawn in the background, and a new click before it was ready brought the game down. Now the old drawing is simply dropped.
pax_corpinc3d_o_flat: Clean 2D map: no mods' buildings and roads
pax_corpinc3d_o_flat_tip: The corporations' buildings (Pax Corporations) and the roads along cities (Pax Corpface) are not drawn on the game's flat map — they are 3D on the globe. Clear it and everything comes back.
pax_corpinc3d_lw_hint: Tab opens/closes it. Drag the window by its title.
pax_corpinc3d_o_layers_tip: Every layer of the 3D Earth — the game's and ours: switch each on and off. Over the globe — the Tab key.
pax_corpinc3d_whatsnew_1_2_0:
• New «Globe layers» window (Tab over the Earth or a button in the «3D» window): every layer switches on and off — roads, rails, power lines, communications, armies (labels and 3D), battles, the front, bases, trade routes, air routes, ships, extraction sites, indicator icons, the political map, economic zones, city names, marks, corporations' buildings, cities, landmarks, satellites, clouds, the atmosphere glow.
• The layers no longer depend on the flat map's «Layers» window: in game 0.24 it and its table were often not found — that is why rails, power lines and armies vanished. Armies are now read straight from the game.
pax_corpinc3d_whatsnew_since: Changes since version %s that you saw last time
pax_corpinc3d_whatsnew_first: The main things the mod has gained

pax_corpinc3d_whatsnew_rec_find: In the game's store: search «%s» by name
pax_corpinc3d_whatsnew_rec_store: The mods are free and in the game's store — open the store and search them by name.
pax_corpinc3d_on_tip: Switch off on a weak computer — the companies stay on the map as marks.
pax_corpinc3d_help: Pax CorpInc3D puts Pax Corporations' company buildings on the 3D Earth. If the game lags, pick a lighter mode: «Economy» keeps only the biggest companies' headquarters, no shadows, hidden when the camera is far; «Off» removes 3D entirely. «Custom» — your own options below. «Lower by itself» drops the mode a step when FPS stays below the threshold.
pax_corpinc3d_needs: Needs the Pax Corporations mod: the 3D buildings stand on its companies' sites.
pax_corpinc3d_where: Close the map and zoom in to the Earth — the buildings appear on the surface.
pax_corpinc3d_rec_corporations: Living corporations: thousands of real companies, a stock market, state stakes, zones and unions. This mod shows their sites and headquarters in 3D.
pax_corpinc3d_rec_corpface: A new interface: the header, the state card, the resource panel, clear «State» and «Relations» windows.
pax_corpinc3d_rec_corptimizer: Smoothness from real measurements: map redraws, an FPS cap, a time-skip screen.
pax_corpinc3d_whatsnew_0_1_0:
• The first version: Pax Corporations' companies stand on the map as 3D models — headquarters (no frame, silver, gold), offices, factories, warehouses. Models are photographed once and drawn as pictures, so the game is hardly loaded.
• The «3D» window: switch the buildings on or off, «?» explains how it works. Console: inc3d on|off.
pax_corpinc3d_whatsnew_0_1_1: • The mouse wheel over the «What's new» window (and other mod windows) scrolls the window — the map below no longer zooms in and out.
pax_corpinc3d_whatsnew_0_1_2: • A new model — the mine: the extraction sites of mining and metals companies. Oil and energy keep the old derrick for now.
pax_corpinc3d_whatsnew_0_1_3: • Two views: on the usual map the buildings are photographed from above (roofs, shadows), in Pax Corpface's isometric view — from the side at an angle, in volume.
pax_corpinc3d_whatsnew_players_tip: Everything players sent through «Contact the developer» and what became of it. Renewed with every update of the mods.
pax_corpinc3d_whatsnew_players_sub: Bugs, wishes and ratings — and the developer's answers. Yours are marked.
pax_corpinc3d_whatsnew_players_none: Nobody has sent anything yet. The 🐞 icon in the header (Pax Corpface) or «Report a bug» (Pax Corptimizer).
pax_corpinc3d_whatsnew_0_1_4: • A new model: the headquarters of diamond companies (world places 1–10) — a futuristic dark monolith, 280 m.
pax_corpinc3d_whatsnew_stories_tip: Memes, screenshots and stories from players' games. Share yours!
pax_corpinc3d_whatsnew_stories_sub: The best players sent — renewed with the mods.
pax_corpinc3d_whatsnew_stories_intro: Something funny or epic happened in your game? Press «Share» below: a page opens where you can attach a picture (a meme or a screenshot — Win+Shift+S) and write the story. The best appear here in the next updates.
pax_corpinc3d_whatsnew_stories_none: Empty so far — be the first!
pax_corpinc3d_whatsnew_share: Share a meme or a story
pax_corpinc3d_whatsnew_share_tip: A page opens: a picture up to 8 MB and/or a text — the developer gets them in the Pax CorpInc group.
pax_corpinc3d_whatsnew_0_2_0:
• The buildings now stand on the real 3D Earth, not on the flat map: each at its own latitude and longitude, right on the surface, as real models. Close the political map and fly low over the Earth — headquarters, offices, factories, warehouses and mines appear; from far away they hide.
• A city's buildings stand on a spiral around its point, not inside each other; the city grows with the camera's height, the proportions between buildings are real.
• Sites without their own model (labs, data centres, derricks) get an office for now.
pax_corpinc3d_whatsnew_feed_tip: The game cannot go online by itself, so this list updates with the mods. The fresh players' messages and the developer's answers are on a page in the browser.
pax_corpinc3d_whatsnew_0_2_1:
• Buildings gather into cities: all companies of one place (half a degree) stand as dense blocks almost touching, the tallest towers in the middle — like the circles on the map, only in 3D. No more buildings scattered over the sea.
• A constant size: buildings neither grow nor shrink with the zoom and always stand on the planet; flying away you see yourself leaving the Earth with its cities.
• Closing the political map turns the Earth to the place you were looking at: zoom out of the USA — and you are over America.
pax_corpinc3d_whatsnew_0_2_2: • Internal: the mod's code is split into separate parts — the main file only connects them. Nothing changes in the game; new features will come faster and with fewer bugs.
pax_corpinc3d_whatsnew_0_2_3:
• Internal: the mod's own data keys are now English (the game's keys are unchanged). Old saves are converted automatically on load.
• Important: update all Pax CorpInc mods together — they exchange data under the new keys.
pax_corpinc3d_whatsnew_0_2_4: • The mod now keeps a journal: its messages and script errors go to the «📜 Mods journal» (Pax Corpface or Pax Corptimizer).
pax_corpinc3d_q_off_text: No 3D buildings — neither on the Earth nor on the map. For the weakest computers.
pax_corpinc3d_q_eco_text: Up to 250 buildings, headquarters only (biggest companies first), no shadows; hidden when the camera is far.
pax_corpinc3d_q_normal_text: Up to 1500 buildings — headquarters, plants, offices, warehouses, mines; no shadows.
pax_corpinc3d_q_max_text: All buildings and shadows. Needs a good graphics card.
pax_corpinc3d_o_limit_tip: Above this number buildings are not placed: headquarters stay first, then companies with the highest frames.
pax_corpinc3d_o_hq_tip: Plants, offices, warehouses and mines are not shown — one building per company.
pax_corpinc3d_o_shadows_tip: Pretty, but noticeably heavier on the graphics card.
pax_corpinc3d_o_far: Hide farther than, Earth radii (0 — never)
pax_corpinc3d_o_far_tip: When the camera is farther than this from the Earth's centre the buildings are not drawn: they cannot be seen from there anyway.
pax_corpinc3d_o_auto: Lower the mode by itself below
pax_corpinc3d_o_auto_tip: If frames per second stay below the threshold for 8 seconds (while buildings are on screen), the mode drops a step: Maximum → Normal → Economy → Off. It never raises it back by itself.
pax_corpinc3d_now: Now: %d FPS · buildings on the Earth: %d
pax_corpinc3d_auto_lowered: 3D buildings: the game lagged — the mode is lowered to «%s». Bring it back in the «3D» window.
pax_corpinc3d_whatsnew_0_2_5:
• The «3D» window is now settings: modes Off / Economy / Normal / Maximum and custom — how many buildings, headquarters only, shadows, hide when far.
• «Lower by itself»: if the game stays below the chosen FPS, the mode drops a step (with a notification).
• The window shows the current FPS and buildings on the Earth. Console: inc3d eco | normal | max | off.
pax_corpinc3d_whatsnew_0_3_0_title: Earth HD and descent into the atmosphere
pax_corpinc3d_whatsnew_0_3_0:
• The Earth from NASA maps: real land and sea colours, city lights at night, clouds with shadows, relief, a glowing atmosphere (now softer).
• The Earth has volume: mountains and valleys are real geometry, seen from the side.
• Descent: at the zoom limit the wheel takes the camera lower, to about 75 km — the view lifts to the horizon, with the sky, mountains from the side and the companies' buildings. Wheel back — up to orbit again.
• The companies' buildings stand on the ground at its height.
• Country borders are smooth and quiet; a bright outline of the country only while its statistics are open.
• Up close the ground is no longer blurry: forests, fields, sand with dunes, rock and snow got their own texture and small lit relief. The colours stay the real ones from NASA maps.
• The flat map layers are now on the 3D Earth: roads, railways, power lines and communications are drawn on the ground itself and grow denser where they were built; trade routes, flights as arcs above the ground, armies, battles, the front, bases, operations, extraction sites and province badges are drawn over the globe. The «Layers» window (Tab) works on the globe too.
• Roads, railways, power lines and communications are real 3D objects on the ground: a raised road with markings, cars (with lights at night), rails with sleepers and trains, power pylons with wires, communication masts with lights. Roads leave the cities, and inside the cities streets join the companies.
• The ground is sharper up close: the map's small contrast and a patchwork of fields.
• At the start — a warning: the mod is experimental, heavy on the computer, crashes and damaged saves are possible. «Don't show again» is available.
pax_corpinc3d_warn_text:
The new 3D Earth: real relief, roads, networks and the companies' buildings on the globe.

[color=#e8b45c]The mod is experimental.[/color] It is heavy on the computer and may noticeably lower performance. The game may crash and [color=#e07a6a]saves may be damaged[/color] — keep backups. You play at your own risk.

Quality settings are in the «3D» window.
pax_corpinc3d_political_tip: Pax CorpInc3D: the countries filled with their colours, thicker borders — as in Terra Invicta. Off — the real Earth with thin borders.
pax_corpinc3d_whatsnew_0_3_9_title: the world's cities, a political map, city names
pax_corpinc3d_whatsnew_0_3_9:
• The Earth has every city of the world from 30 000 people, from real data: grey built-up land instead of green fields and lights at night; closer — buildings, hundreds in a megacity, taller to the middle.
• A political map, as in Terra Invicta: the countries in their colours, thicker borders. A box in the «Layers» window (Tab).
• City names on the globe: the closer, the more cities; capitals with a star. Switched off in the same window.
• Country borders are clear, in the country's colour; the checkerboard «fields» are gone.
• Clouds: a map of their own, dark at night (no more purple glow), fewer.
• Roads and railways show wherever people live, even when the game gave no data of its own; at night the roads are threads of light between the cities.
• The Great Lakes and other inland waters are water, not dark patches; buildings no longer stand in water.
• Real NASA maps: the Earth's colour — Blue Marble (16K), the night lights — Black Marble 2016. Read in the background without slowing the game; the game's own map for the first seconds.
pax_corpinc3d_whatsnew_0_3_8:
• Roads no longer sink under the ground or look see-through.
• The haze near the ground is lighter still.
pax_corpinc3d_whatsnew_0_3_7_title: WASD, wide roads, buildings of one size
pax_corpinc3d_whatsnew_0_3_7:
• Near the ground W A S D fly over the land (Shift — faster).
• Roads and railways are wider and easier to see.
• The buildings no longer change size when zooming in and out.
pax_corpinc3d_whatsnew_0_3_6_title: the mod's own flight near the ground, a steady rim
pax_corpinc3d_whatsnew_0_3_6:
• Near the ground the mod drives the camera: a drag moves the land right under the cursor at any height, the camera no longer drifts on its own. A click on a province or a company works as before.
• The Earth's rim no longer blinks: the air and cloud shells are drawn in a fixed order.
• Roads and railways read light from afar, as on photos from orbit, and thicker.
pax_corpinc3d_whatsnew_0_3_5_title: a smooth camera, Tab, no front
pax_corpinc3d_whatsnew_0_3_5:
• Near the ground the camera no longer shakes: it follows the turn smoothly and slowly.
• Tab over the globe opens the layers window, not the flat map.
• The clouds clear away close in, the haze near the ground is lighter.
• The front's red zigzags are gone from the globe.
pax_corpinc3d_whatsnew_0_3_4_title: slower near the ground, the clouds part
pax_corpinc3d_whatsnew_0_3_4:
• Near the Earth the camera turns and goes down slower — the lower, the smoother.
• Coming close the clouds part and no longer cover the land.
• The automatic quality step no longer switches the 3D buildings and roads off — it stops at «Eco».
pax_corpinc3d_whatsnew_0_3_3_title: the descent without the flat map, a clean Earth
pax_corpinc3d_whatsnew_0_3_3:
• Zooming in to the Earth no longer switches to the flat map, and near the ground the camera moves slower.
• Front lines no longer cover the planet with red strokes: they are thin and show only close in.
• The atmosphere's rim no longer blinks in the menu.
pax_corpinc3d_whatsnew_0_3_2_title: the descent and a softer atmosphere
pax_corpinc3d_whatsnew_0_3_2:
• The wheel close to the Earth again takes the camera down into the air instead of opening the flat map.
• The atmosphere's rim is thinner and more natural: pale blue, no violet cast, the sunset a narrow band.
pax_corpinc3d_whatsnew_0_3_1:
• The mod is moved to game 0.24: the buildings' models, the Earth's settings and the «What's new» window read correctly again; the camera, the map layers on the globe and the country outline follow the game's new names.
• If the globe shows no armies, trade routes or roads — type inc3d probe in the console and send the output to the author.
pax_corpinc3d_whatsnew_0_4_0_title: country selection, a clean Earth, Tab
pax_corpinc3d_whatsnew_0_4_0:
• A click on a country on the globe selects it: lighter, a pulsing light along its edge and a bright border. A click on the sea or on it again clears it.
• The old game Earth's «mosaic» and fields under the NASA map are gone — by day and by night.
• Clouds no longer glow violet and orange on the night side.
• The bases' squares on the globe are gone.
• Tab over the globe opens the «Layers» window in its place, not the flat map.
• Zooming stops at the overview height again (~830 km).
• The cities' houses are no longer white.
pax_corpinc3d_whatsnew_0_4_1_title: own clouds, the rim, ground under the cities
pax_corpinc3d_whatsnew_0_4_1:
• The clouds no longer glow violet and orange at night — the mod has its own cloud layer now.
• The Earth's rim is the sun's blue light, no lilac; the aurora is a faint green, at night only.
• The mouse wheel in the game's windows scrolls the window, not the camera.
• The camera can come a little lower (~575 km).
• The cities' houses and the companies' quarters stand on grey ground, not on grass.
• Every country has its border outline now, not only the known ones, and neighbours of similar colours no longer merge.
pax_corpinc3d_whatsnew_0_4_2:
• A click on a company's building on the globe opens its dossier.
• Tab over the globe opens the «Layers» window again — on the screen, under the top bar.
pax_corpinc3d_whatsnew_1_0_0:
• Every city of the world has houses by its size: hundreds in a megacity, a couple in a small town. Grey blocks under them.
• Armies stand on the globe as an armoured car and three soldiers: one keeps watch, one works, one patrols.
• Container ships sail the sea — on the trade routes and across the ocean.
• New satellites in orbit.
• A click on a country — its card with statistics (Pax Corporations).
• Roads and cities are built on background threads — the game does not freeze.
pax_corpinc3d_whatsnew_1_0_1:
• The «Economic zones» box in the «Layers» window tints the zones' countries in their colours right on the globe.
• The «Layers» window on the globe no longer goes under the header.
pax_corpinc3d_o_air_tip: The air's blue glow at the Earth's rim and the sky near the ground. Switch it off if you dislike the planet's glow.
pax_corpinc3d_regions_hint: Hover a region — what is known of it.
pax_corpinc3d_whatsnew_1_1_0:
• 15 famous landmarks on the Earth: the Eiffel Tower, the pyramids, the Statue of Liberty, the Kremlin, the Taj Mahal and more.
• A second click on the chosen country — a ring animation and the map of its regions, with details on hover.
• Rails and power lines run between real cities.
• The Earth turns with the game's time: a turn a day.
• Countries lightly tinted — the borders show better.
• The poles can be seen from above; a click on the Earth no longer jumps to a satellite.
• The atmosphere's glow can be switched off in the «3D» window.
